security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown examples, style-guide placeholders, and bounded notebook review logic. The confirmed risk is command injection in validate_notebook.py where a user-controlled notebook path is interpolated into sh -c commands for detect-secrets. No prompt injection or intentional data exfiltration language was found in the reviewed skill files.

remediation.issue: User-controlled notebook paths are interpolated into shell command strings before xargs execution.
remediation.suggestion: Replace the sh -c and echo pipeline with direct subprocess argument lists, or pass file paths through stdin without shell parsing.

remediation.issue: The validator depends on external tools during review.
remediation.suggestion: Document that uv, jupyter nbconvert, and detect-secrets may run locally, and keep arguments fixed and quoted by subprocess rather than a shell.

subprocess.run receives a fixed argument list for uv and jupyter, with the notebook path passed as one argument. There is no shell interpolation at this call site.
subprocess.run invokes sh -c with a command string built from the user-provided notebook path. A path containing a single quote could break out of the quoting and inject shell commands.
The shell command embeds notebook_abs inside single quotes before piping to xargs. Because notebook_abs comes from the requested notebook path, crafted filenames can alter the shell command.

content.value_statement: Notebook reviews are hard to make consistent across narrative quality, code quality, and technical accuracy. This skill combines automated validation with a clear rubric for Anthropic Cookbook submissions.
actual_capabilities: Reviews Cookbook notebooks against a structured four-part scoring rubric.
Guides reviewers to read the included style guide before scoring.
Runs a local notebook validator to convert notebooks to Markdown and flag technical issues.
Checks for setup, dotenv usage, model constants, deprecated patterns, and noisy output.
Produces an executive summary, detailed scores, recommendations, and concrete examples.
limitations: Requires access to the notebook file and local Python tooling.
Automated checks do not replace manual review of pedagogy and narrative flow.
The validator focuses on Anthropic Cookbook standards, not general notebook publishing rules.
External validation tools may need installation before the full workflow can run.

use_cases.title: Review a New Cookbook Submission
use_cases.description: Apply the rubric before merging a notebook into a Cookbook repository.

use_cases.title: Improve an Existing Tutorial Notebook
use_cases.description: Identify gaps in setup, explanation, outputs, and conclusion quality.

use_cases.title: Standardize Team Review Feedback
use_cases.description: Use a shared scoring format so multiple reviewers give consistent guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Notebook Audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this Cookbook notebook: [path]. Use the standard rubric and give a score with the top improvements.

prompt_templates.title: Focus on Narrative Quality
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit [path] with extra focus on introduction, learning objectives, section flow, and conclusion quality.

prompt_templates.title: Pre-Merge Technical Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the Cookbook audit for [path]. Include automated validation issues, code quality concerns, and publication blockers.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced Comparative Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Improve a notebook using rubric-based examples.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit [path] and provide rewritten examples for weak sections using the style guide templates as the reference.

output_examples.input: Audit a draft notebook about building a support triage agent.
output: Overall score with strengths and critical issues.
Dimension scores for narrative, code quality, technical accuracy, and actionability.

output_examples.input: Review only the setup and prerequisites section.
output: Feedback on required knowledge and tools.
Warnings about noisy install output or weak environment setup.
Suggested improvements aligned with Cookbook standards.

output_examples.input: Check whether a notebook is ready for publication.
output: Blocking technical issues and non-blocking quality warnings.
Concrete next steps for the author.

best_practices: Read the style guide before auditing so feedback matches current Cookbook standards.
Run the validator before manual review to catch technical issues early.
Give specific examples and section references instead of generic writing advice.
anti_patterns: Scoring a notebook without checking the style guide first.
Treating automated validation as a complete quality review.
Giving broad feedback without actionable examples or line references.

faq.question: What does this skill review?
faq.answer: It reviews Anthropic Cookbook notebooks for narrative quality, code quality, technical accuracy, and actionability.

faq.question: Does it run automated checks?
faq.answer: Yes. It can run the included validator to convert notebooks to Markdown and detect common technical issues.

faq.question: Can it replace a human editor?
faq.answer: No. It supports human review but still requires judgment about teaching quality and audience fit.

faq.question: What files does it use?
faq.answer: It uses the skill instructions, the included style guide, and the notebook validator script.

faq.question: Who should use this skill?
faq.answer: It is best for authors, reviewers, and documentation teams preparing Cookbook notebooks for publication.

faq.question: What output should I expect?
faq.answer: Expect an executive summary, scores by dimension, specific recommendations, and suggested improvements.
